div.p: One personalized tracker.mjs, plain Node stdlib, user-scoped install. It runs pinned ccusage local usage reader, uploads bounded JSON, then self-updates by SHA-256.

ul.li: No package manifest, app deps, transpilation, or bundling.
ccusage execution is pinned, timed, and output-limited.
Upload body is size-limited; source-detail reports may be dropped to fit.
Scheduler is user-scoped, no root or administrator install.

text.tspan: base URL + one `tt_*` token baked in
PI_* env, settings.json, saved scheduler path
known reports, row limits, future tolerance
